_comment: Standalone faceless long-form engine — discovery + legal sourcing config. NO brand funnel. The scout decides BOTH the niche and the format from live trend + retention signals, then only proceeds if footage can be sourced legally (CC / public-domain / licensed stock). candidate_niche_probes updated from Q2 2026 deep-dive research (see YT_Longform_Trends_2026Q2.md). Edit weights/sources freely; the scout is fully niche-agnostic.
mission: Pick whatever long-form niche+format is trending hardest and retaining best on YouTube right now, that we can produce from legally-clean footage, and publish it on repeat.

scout_scoring._comment: Final score = weighted sum of normalized 0-1 signals. No brand/funnel term. sourcing_feasibility is a HARD GATE, not a weight — if footage can't be sourced legally, the topic is dropped regardless of score.

hard_gates.sourcing_feasibility: Drop topic if we cannot assemble >= target_minutes of legally-licensed footage/visuals for it.

scout_scoring.trend_velocity_note: Rate of growth, not absolute volume. A niche climbing fast with thin competition beats a saturated giant. Derive from YouTube search recency + view-velocity of top recent uploads + Google Trends slope.
scout_scoring.retention_proxy_note: Score the FORMAT, then refine with real channel data once the retention loop has it. Until then use format archetype priors below.

format_archetypes._comment: Long-form shapes ranked by typical audience retention. Scout favors topics that fit a high-retention shape. PRIORS — overwritten per-niche once your own Analytics data exists.

candidate_niche_probes._comment: Seeds the scout explores and ranks — NOT a fixed list; the scout may discover new niches from trending data. UPDATED from Q2 2026 deep-dive research. research_demand is a qualitative seed signal; the scout still verifies live demand/competition/sourcing per topic. title_formulas reference IDs in title_formulas.json.

probes.label: Boring history to sleep to
probes.note: Best automation fit + proven multi-million, but very crowded with AI now. Differentiate on accuracy/voice quality.

probes.label: Long-form true crime / interrogation
probes.footage_profile: LICENSED/CC only + AI reconstruction; PD court docs
probes.note: High CPM. Footage is the constraint — use CC/licensed + AI reconstruction, never ripped footage.

probes.label: Iceberg explained deep-dives
probes.note: Built-in escalating-curiosity structure; excellent retention shape.

probes.label: Cinematic business rise-and-fall
probes.note: Highest $/view (business CPM). MagnatesMedia model. Needs strong scripting.

probes.label: Reddit story compilations
probes.note: Trivially faceless (TTS+text). Crowded; win on story curation + thumbnail.

probes.label: Animated educational explainers
probes.note: Curiosity-gap + clean visuals; evergreen, high share. Mostly AI-generated = clean rights.

probes.label: Ambient sleep / soundscapes
probes.footage_profile: CC0 nature stock + AI loops; royalty-free audio
probes.note: Massive watch-time per view, near-zero production, ~$16-20 CPM wellness ads. Crowded but durable.

probes.label: Premium history documentaries
probes.note: Authoritative deep narrative; loyal binge audience. Lean on public-domain archival.

probes.label: Unsolved mysteries and speculative
probes.note: Pure open-loop; title question only answered at the end.

legal_sources._comment: ONLY pull footage/visuals from here. Every clip used MUST be logged in the ledger with source, source_id, license, and attribution_required. This license manifest is your monetization/strike defense.

video.name: youtube_cc
video.caution: Verify each clip is genuinely CC and download via legal means; respect attribution.

production._comment: Each long-form also yields N Shorts from its highest-retention segments to feed the algorithm and grow the channel.
